paper_title: When Hostnames Become Code: Detecting Persisted Hostname Injection at Production Scale

install.command: conda env create -f environment.yml && conda activate ccd

ieee_sp_artifact_requirements.aec_contact_note: Provide at least one responsive contact author in HotCRP; no personal contact data is stored in the public repository.

public_research_infrastructure.notes: Kick-the-tires, tests, release gates, and aggregate recomputation run on commodity CPU Linux/macOS hosts or public research infrastructure with Python 3.11. No SSH service, GUI, paid API, production-network access, special hardware, or GPU is required for the public artifact path.

runtime.kick_the_tires_runtime: A few minutes on a laptop CPU after dependencies are installed.
runtime.full_tests_runtime: Under one day on commodity CPU hardware.
runtime.scaled_down_justification: The checked-in 150-row HIB sample proves release mechanics, privacy gates, fixed-FPR replay code paths, detector mechanics, and aggregate recomputation. Paper-scale row-level replay requires staging the external 200,339,886-row HIB-Real bundle.

kick_the_tires.runtime: A few minutes on a laptop CPU after dependencies are installed.

components.name: Stability, drift, and scope aggregate accounting

claims.claim: CCD scoring and split-conformal thresholding are executable from the public code.
claims.script: python -m pytest tests/test_scoring.py tests/test_cone.py tests/test_model_pipeline.py tests/test_calibration.py
claims.expected: Tests pass and exercise Eq. 1 mixture cone scoring, exact full-axis scanning for the deployed top-R cone sketch that bypasses LSH by default, fixed-FPR global and grouped threshold selection, benign-reference refresh, and optional global/grouped calibrated-threshold persistence in model bundles.

claims.claim: Finite-edit decision-stability helpers implement deterministic manifest closure.
claims.expected: Tests pass and exercise margin-bound certificates, deterministic edit-ball enumeration, and rejection on decision flips.

claims.claim: CAHO benchmark training supports the deployed contrastive plus binary-auxiliary training path.
claims.expected: Tests pass and exercise BenchmarkBinaryContrastiveTrainer fit/save behavior with a two-view dataset, chunk-aware shuffled training order, and binary classifier head.

claims.claim: Table 1 and Appendix C method contracts are executable and release-safe.
claims.expected: The output reports status=pass, validates Table 1 contract rows, checks CCD default configuration against Appendix C, verifies E1-E11 edit-manifest coverage, deterministic finite-edit closure, calibrated-margin certificates with enumeration fallback, confirms exact full-axis scanning for the deployed top-R cone sketch that bypasses LSH by default for calibration/certification, confirms global and tenant/window grouped split-conformal threshold support, confirms benign-only P_B/threshold refresh support, confirms CAHO two-view supervised orbit contrastive plus binary-head training support with benign diversity preservation, L2-normalized binary inputs, explicit AdamW weight decay, and benchmark binary-trainer defaults matching the Appendix C deployed recipe, and confirms model bundles can persist config, axes, priors, and global/grouped calibrated thresholds.

claims.claim: Named paper claims, figures, tables, equations, and appendices are mapped to artifact evidence and explicit external boundaries.
claims.expected: The output reports status=pass, validates 33 coverage items covering five contributions, Eq. 1, Proposition 5.1, Lemma C.1, Figures 1-7, Tables 1-12, and Appendices A-F, checks referenced artifact paths and manifest claim alignment, and requires full-data or production-private dependencies to remain represented as external completion items.

claims.claim: The paper's headline numeric claims are centrally audited against release-safe aggregate artifacts.
claims.expected: The output reports status=pass, validates nine abstract/contribution/conclusion headline anchors, including 200,339,886 replay rows, 835 tenants, CCD 0.935 TPR at the fixed-FPR operating point, 0.60 ms full-path latency, 850 CCD-only verified live positives, 363,401 verified positives, 98% K=6 decision-stability coverage, 50-repo source reachability, 118/127 public-scope mapping, and hostile-mimicry recall ranges.

claims.claim: All release-safe paper-claim checks can be run from one evaluator command.
claims.expected: The output reports status=pass, runs 14 release-safe checks including the readiness audit, method contracts, paper-claim coverage, headline-claim anchors, HIB profile, evaluation accounting, source reachability, public scope, production latency, live overlap, sink evidence, metric tables, stability/scope aggregates, and public sample fixed-FPR replay metrics.

claims.claim: The artifact can be kicked-the-tires without private data.
claims.expected: The command compiles code, validates the public bundle in-repo and after extraction, recomputes sample replay metrics, trains a tiny CCD model, calibrates fixed-FPR global and grouped thresholds into a self-contained model bundle, refreshes P_B plus global/grouped thresholds from a benign window, scores, explains, and certifies from that refreshed bundle with grouped thresholds, evaluates the CAHO checkpoint, and prints artifact smoke status: pass.

claims.claim: A clean DOI-ready archive can be assembled from the worktree.
claims.expected: The command verifies required manifest paths, excludes local caches, virtualenvs, and intermediate training checkpoints, summarizes archive contents, and exits with status=pass.

claims.claim: The checked-in public HIB sample bundle satisfies release gates and does not disclose raw-hostname recurrence facts.
claims.expected: The validator exits successfully with status=pass and row_count_checked=150.

claims.claim: Public replay metrics can be recomputed from released rows.
claims.expected: The output includes label_accounting, calibration, fixed_fpr_replay, resolved_row_replay, and detector_overlap blocks; the checked-in sample reports grouped public calibration, fixed_fpr_replay.status=available, and nonzero TP/FP/TN/FN cells.

claims.claim: HIB dataset-profile and verified-positive profile aggregate accounting is release-safe and recomputable.
claims.expected: The output reports status=pass, validates Table 3 source/resolved/unresolved rows, Appendix B label and capture-policy counts, Table 4/Table 9 verified-positive family and obfuscation denominators, and derives replay prevalence and profile consistency checks.

claims.claim: Evaluation units and reproducibility boundaries are release-safe and recomputable.
claims.expected: The output reports status=pass, validates Table 2 denominator units, validates Appendix E/Table 11 released-versus-withheld boundaries, confirms unresolved rows are excluded from resolved replay denominators, and checks that Table 11 external boundaries are represented in manifest external completion items.

claims.claim: Static source-reachability accounting for the paper's 50-repo scope check is release-safe and recomputable.
claims.expected: The output reports status=pass with the paper's CodeQL and Semgrep true-positive, false-positive, and missed-delayed-path counts plus derived precision/recall accounting.

claims.claim: Public-scope taxonomy accounting is release-safe and separates public anchors from HIB positives.
claims.expected: The output reports status=pass with 118/127 post-freeze public reports mapped to target categories, allowed exclusion reasons, and public anchors marked as not counted in HIB training or production positives.

claims.claim: The artifact exposes a local latency smoke benchmark for the encoder and CCD scoring kernel.
claims.expected: The command reports status=pass and emits hardware-dependent encoder and ccd_scores_logpriors_topk timing fields without asserting the paper's production latency numbers on evaluator hardware.

claims.claim: Production latency and throughput aggregates are release-safe and recomputable.
claims.expected: The output reports status=pass, validates Figure 5 full-path latency and throughput aggregates, scoring-kernel latency ordering, Table 5 CCD p99/p99.9 alignment, and the local-smoke boundary that evaluator hardware is not expected to reproduce production latency.

claims.claim: Live-overlap aggregate accounting is release-safe and recomputable.
claims.expected: The output reports status=pass, reconstructs Table 7 overlap cells, derives CCD-only verified live positives, lower-bound reviewed-item PPV, per-day nonverified review load, and marks controlled case-study traces as non-compromise claims.

claims.claim: Controlled sink-evidence traces for audited metadata-to-code paths are release-safe and recomputable.
claims.expected: The output reports status=pass, validates the three Table 8 controlled matching-sink replay cases, requires parser/persistence/consumer/effect/detector-boundary fields, verifies CCD fired before downstream consumption, and records the traces as evidence rather than production-compromise claims.

claims.claim: Aggregate paper metric tables for baseline audit, ablations, hostile mimicry, and synthetic-real validity are release-safe and recomputable.
claims.expected: The output reports status=pass, validates Tables 5, 6, 10, and 12 plus Appendix F aggregate metrics, and derives summary checks such as CCD's Table 5 TPR lead, largest white-box ablation drop, LLM checkpoint coverage, weakest hostile-mimicry cell, and real-training gain over LLM priors.

claims.claim: Decision-stability, family-holdout/depth, drift-refresh, and public-real scope aggregates are release-safe and recomputable.
claims.expected: The output reports status=pass, validates Figure 7 finite-edit certificate coverage and scope limits, Section 8.2 holdout/depth ranges, Section 8.3 benign-only drift-refresh invariants, independent replay tolerance, and public-real recall ordering.

claims.claim: Paper-scale headline metrics require the separate full HIB-Real de-identified release.
claims.expected: After the full bundle is staged, the same validators and recompute_metrics.py command validate the 200,339,886-row replay.

external_completion_items: Deposit the final artifact in a permanent public repository with a DOI.
Replace example.org placeholders in metadata.template.toml with final anonymous submission and DOI-backed URLs.
Attach or reference the full HIB-Real de-identified release bundle.
Attach the full source-reachability public corpus manifest and labeled CodeQL/Semgrep outputs if evaluators need to rerun the 50-repo static-analysis scope check end to end.
Attach public-report label exports if evaluators need to rerun public-scope taxonomy coverage from individual reports rather than release-safe aggregates.
Attach production latency traces or official timing outputs if evaluators need to audit Figure 5 from raw serving measurements rather than release-safe aggregates.
Attach masked live-overlap case-chain labels if evaluators need to rerun Table 7 accounting from row-level summaries rather than release-safe aggregates.
Attach masked sink-evidence case-chain exports if evaluators need to audit Table 8 from row-level traces rather than release-safe aggregates.

Attach full replay, ablation, LLM-baseline identifier provenance, and hostile-mimicry run outputs if evaluators need to rerun Tables 5, 6, 10, and 12 from row-level predictions/stress cases rather than release-safe aggregates.

Attach full stability, drift, family-holdout, composition-depth, and public-real outputs if evaluators need to rerun Figure 6/Figure 7 and scope checks from row-level cases rather than release-safe aggregates.
Run the full replay commands from ARTIFACT_EVALUATION.md on the full bundle and archive the resulting metrics.
